js: 'Traffic and Conversations as lists beside the opened record (modern design WP10), on the faked request log and conversations of scripts/drive/records-fake.js: the status page beside the list at a wide window, a click opens a request at its path, the arrows move the selection, an error opens with its message, a request the list does not hold opens by its id (a deep link) and an answer for one no longer opened is dropped, the model search (/ focuses, Esc clears) narrows the list and keeps the opened request, the filters popover (errors only lights its button and filters the list, Clear filters), Load older appends and pauses the live tail, Resume, the Requests and Conversations switch, the old ?chain= link landing on the chain path, a conversation with its turns and what it waits for, Delete asking first (Keep it), and the narrow window (one pane at a time, the back button). Nothing is written: the fake answers the reads, and the only write it could reach (Delete) is cancelled. Run: scripts/ui-drive.py scripts/drive/traffic-split.json --init-script scripts/drive/records-fake.js --dsf 1.25 --token-file <dir>.token --base http://<addr>'
